question: How can ordinary builds bind Suit11's charge efficiency and Ultimate-triggered team ATK without manual proc declarations?
stop_condition: Bind source-owned 12% efficiency and 15%/20s nonstacking team ATK with executable trigger, refresh and resource tests.
return_condition: New consumer evidence resolves which individual energy grants bypass efficiency and the native fractional resource representation.
rationale: The frozen set description and GetEfficiency2_4 curves agree on 15% ATK for 20 seconds after the wearer's Ultimate, including the wearer and without stacking. Reapplication refreshes the single shared buff and different wearers cannot stack it. Q-start lifecycle evidence supports activation on admitted Ultimate cast, before its hit. ChargeGetEfficiencyBase is 1 on native characters; the two-piece modifier adds 0.12. Model numeric charge grants using the recipient's multiplier, retaining a rational carry until a whole unit is available. Explicit pool-fill restoration bypasses efficiency. This preserves the integer ledger without discarding fractional generation; grant eligibility/rounding are visible hypotheses.
affected_scenarios: Ordinary NTE gcsl builds with Speedy Hedgehog count >= 2/4. Exact research snapshots with manual_procs=1 retain their supplied handlers.
limits: Only existing implemented charge-grant callbacks are scaled; ordinary skill/attack generation still requires its own native adapter.
Charge eligibility and rational carry are tested modeling policies, not verified native resource precision.
checks: Frozen parameter/provenance and independent Fraction arithmetic
Actual WASM combat: Ultimate trigger, self/team recipients, nonstacking refresh, expiry boundary, failed admission, fractional energy conservation and exact configuration roundtrip
